title: ranunculus amplexicaulis var. plantagineus
intro: Ranunculus amplexicaulis var. plantagineus, commonly known as a variety of the creeping buttercup, is a flowering plant that belongs to the family Ranunculaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe wounds and reduce pain. The therapeutic actions of Ranunculus amplexicaulis var. plantagineus include its ability to act as a vulnerary, which is a substance that promotes the healing of wounds, and its antiseptic properties, which may help to prevent infection. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, although further research is needed to fully understand its chemical composition and potential uses.
